2609.21713.title: TERMon: Detecting Persistent Behavioral Threats in Edge AI via Hardware-Native Ternary Runtime Monitor
2609.21713.paper_summary: Edge AI accelerators are increasingly deployed in safety-critical environments, where model outputs may control physical actuators, make access-control decisions, or trigger alarms. In these settings, runtime failures often remain undetected because model corruption, distribution shift, and adversarial inputs can still produce well-formed, confident predictions. This paper presents TERMon, a lightweight hardware runtime monitor that detects such anomalies by observing inference behavior rather than re-executing or formally verifying the model. TERMon represents class-conditional trusted behavior as hardware-efficient ternary patterns that are matched in parallel against a thermometer-encoded fingerprint. The ternary encoding reproduces the corresponding unquantized range decision exactly. TERMon detects harmful weight corruptions in proportion to their behavioral impact, while out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs are largely not separable using the monitored features at a strict false-positive operating point. We implemented TERMon on a PYNQ-Z2 FPGA, and the pipelined design requires no on-chip block RAM or DSPs and has a two-cycle decision latency.
2609.21713.paper_summary_zh: 邊緣 AI 加速器越來越多地部署在安全關鍵環境中，這些環境中模型的輸出可能控制物理執行器、做出訪問控制決策或觸發警報。<lb/>在這些情況下，運行時故障往往無法被檢測到，因為模型損壞、分佈轉移和對抗性輸入仍然可以產生良好形成且自信的預測。<lb/>本文提出了 TERMon，一種輕量級的硬體運行時監控器，通過觀察推理行為而不是重新執行或正式驗證模型來檢測這些異常。<lb/>TERMon 將類條件的可信行為表示為硬體高效的三元模式，並與熱計碼指紋並行匹配。<lb/>三元編碼精確地再現了相應的未量化範圍決策。<lb/>TERMon 根據其行為影響檢測有害的權重損壞，而使用監控特徵在嚴格的假陽性操作點下，分佈外和對抗性輸入在很大程度上是不可分的。<lb/>我們在 PYNQ-Z2 FPGA 上實現了 TERMon，管線設計不需要片上塊 RAM 或 DSP，並且具有兩個周期的決策延遲。
